name: Synthetic fixture: asteroid with a shape model (433 Eros: real shape, size, albedo, class and spin)

diameter_km.source: synthetic fixture: real 433 Eros value, JPL SBDB diameter (Yeomans et al. (2000) Science v.289, pp.2085-2088), as in the backend's recorded SBDB reply

shape_source.source: synthetic fixture: real 433 Eros value, Gaskell, R.W., Gaskell Eros Shape Model V1.1, urn:nasa:pds:gaskell.ast-eros.shape-model, NASA PDS, DOI 10.26033/d0gq-9427, CC0-1.0 (backend/assets/shapes/registry.toml)

rot_period_h.source: synthetic fixture: real 433 Eros value, JPL SBDB rot_per (LCDB (Rev. 2023-October); Warner et al., 2009), as in the backend's recorded SBDB reply

albedo.source: synthetic fixture: real 433 Eros value, JPL SBDB albedo (Veverka et al. (2000) Science v.289, pp.2088-2097), as in the backend's recorded SBDB reply

gaia_rgb.source: synthetic fixture: not a real measurement
gaia_rgb.formula: stands in for the Gaia colour conversion, which is not specified here

spherex_rgb.source: synthetic fixture: not a real measurement

spectral_class.source: synthetic fixture: real 433 Eros value, JPL SBDB spec_B (SMASS taxonomy; EAR-A-5-DDR-TAXONOMY-V4.0), as in the backend's recorded SBDB reply

phase_angle_deg.source: synthetic fixture: not a real measurement

sun_vector.source: synthetic fixture: not a real measurement
